summary: A driver who refused to yield led officers on a prolonged pursuit along Madison Street. Speeds climbed to about 55 mph with no pedestrians or other traffic on the roadway, and there was a brief concern over a possible gunshot as the chase continued northbound.

area: near Edwards Air Force Base, eastern Kern County
summary: Reports of smoke from a building drew a large assignment including multiple engines and a battalion in the Edwards Air Force Base area. Crews found only light residual smoke extending into the attic, cancelled reinforcements and reduced the response to a regular structure fire.

An employee watching surveillance footage saw two hooded males force their way into a business and begin taking items. The employee then lost connection to the cameras, possibly because they had been removed by the suspects.

Domestic incident in progress — a caller could be heard yelling in the background before the suspect began chasing her. Officers responded; the caller reported being struck in the 21st and D Street area.
Female caller on an open line reported a man had tried to strangle her during an active verbal dispute. The subject was last seen gathering belongings outside the residence.
Report of an outside fire on E Street; crews dispatched.
Welfare check for a possible child-endangerment matter in which a juvenile said an older brother had choked him and covered his mouth. Officers responding.
Officers took a report of a missing 8-year-old girl.
Medical response to a motel for a guest with stroke symptoms; crews dispatched.
Welfare check for a possible battery situation in the Braham Street and 90th Street West area; units checking.
